title: Model Output
description: Raw and parsed output from a model. Always preserves the raw text, even if parsing fails.

run_marker.description: Run marker that was injected into the prompt. If not present in output, indicates context pollution or misalignment.

raw_text.description: Complete raw text output from the model. MUST be preserved as-is.

parsed_json.description: Parsed JSON if extraction succeeded, null otherwise.

schema_valid.description: Whether parsed_json passes bet_receipt schema validation.

matched_text.description: The text fragment that triggered this signal.

pollution_signals.description: Detected pollution signals. Populated by classify_model_output.py in P9.3.
